calculation_handling.description: Exclusion rule: the gross floor area of ancillary buildings is not counted in a lot's total gross floor area or floor space index.
calculation_handling.gaps: Also affects gfa_m2 (total gross floor area); fsi is named as the defined variable.

evidence.frontage_band: a lot frontage of 12.0 metres or more

calculation_handling.description: On a lot with frontage of 12.0 m or more, the total floor area of all ancillary buildings or structures (excluding outdoor pools and other water-holding structures) is at most 60.0 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: The text says 'total floor area' (not 'interior floor area' or 'gross floor area'); interior_floor_area_m2 is the closest target. It is a total across all ancillary buildings on the lot, not per building. Outdoor swimming pools are excluded from the total.

calculation_handling.description: In all other cases (lot frontage under 12.0 m), the total floor area of all ancillary buildings or structures (excluding outdoor pools) is at most 40.0 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: 'in all other cases' is the complement of (2)(A); the condition's 12.0 m threshold is taken from (2)(A), as this clause states no number for it. interior_floor_area_m2 is the closest target for 'total floor area'.

calculation_handling.description: An ancillary building or structure located less than 1.8 m from a residential building on the lot may have a floor area of at most 10.0 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: The distance to the residential building is a scenario value (distance_to_residential_m); the limit applies per ancillary building, not as a lot total. interior_floor_area_m2 is the closest target for 'floor area'.

10.5.60.50(1).explanation: In residential zones, the floor area of sheds, detached garages and other ancillary buildings does not count toward the lot's gross floor area or floor space index.

10.5.60.50(2).explanation: The combined floor area of all ancillary buildings and structures on a residential lot (not counting outdoor pools) can be at most 60.0 m2 on a lot 12.0 m wide or more, and at most 40.0 m2 on narrower lots.

10.5.60.50(3).explanation: An ancillary building or structure placed less than 1.8 m from the house can be at most 10.0 m2 in floor area.
